FFIRONSWORN.Label: Ironsworn / Starforged
FFIRONSWORN.CoreTooOld: FastFighting Ironsworn needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFIRONSWORN.CoreUntested: FastFighting Ironsworn hasn't been tried with FastFighting Core API {major}; some things may not work.
FFIRONSWORN.NeedsCore: FastFighting Ironsworn needs FastFighting Core. Enable it in Manage Modules.

rulesPreference.Name: Rules preference
rulesPreference.Hint: With several rulesets on, which version of a shared move (Strike, Clash, Endure Harm, Enter the Fray) a character makes: its own sheet's, or the preferred ruleset's if the world has it on.

deadlyWeapons.Name: Characters fight with deadly weapons
deadlyWeapons.Hint: Ironsworn's Strike and Clash. On: a hit inflicts 2 harm (a strong hit 3). Off: 1 (a strong hit 2), as a simple weapon or bare hands do.

doorHarm.Name: Ironsworn only: harm to break down a locked door
doorHarm.Hint: Harm a locked door takes before it gives way, hacked at. 3: two hits with a deadly weapon; 1: any hit. With one track for the encounter (Starforged), one hit always does it. A door's own hit points (set on its wall) come first.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's next attack or Compel is to succeed after a hit sizing a foe up (Secure an Advantage). A Strike gets all it can by about 1.5×; the rest helps Compel a hardier foe.

Burn.Strong: burns momentum ({n}): {label} is a strong hit
Burn.Weak: burns momentum ({n}): {label} is a weak hit

Endure.MortalDies: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: miss. Dies
Endure.MortalBack: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: lives, out of the fight
Endure.MortalBound: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: lives, deathbound, out of the fight
Endure.Dying: dying (d100 {d100}): needs healing within an hour or two

Stress.Desolate: overwhelmed (d100 {d100}); {face}: miss. Gives up the fight

Allegiance.Success: joins the fight beside them: a success (progress marked, {n} ticks)
Allegiance.Bolster: joins the fight beside them: +1 momentum each
Allegiance.Harder: turns on them: the objective is harder ({rank})
Allegiance.Dread: turns on them, and it weighs on them all

Conflict.Title: Conflict
Conflict.Hint: How the encounter's progress is tracked.
Conflict.TrackHint: One track for the encounter (Starforged) or one per foe (Ironsworn).
Conflict.EncounterHint: Every foe shares it; Take Decisive Action wins it.
Conflict.FoesHint: End the Fight takes a foe out.
Conflict.RankHint: How hard the objective is: progress per mark, and successes to talk a foe round.
Conflict.HolderHint: The character whose sheet keeps the encounter's track.

Out.Deathbound: Survives Face Death, bound to a deathbound quest; out cold
Out.Dying: Dying: needs healing within an hour or two, or Face Death

Provoke.Shrugs: rises to it, then shrugs it off
